scope: read-only review of source repo preservation, archive boundaries, and recovery risks

checks.evidence: experiment_round2_3datasets: 4 tracked modified files; 220 untracked items; git diff --stat 4,184 insertions/22 deletions; 642 ignored entries. Preserve HEAD/index/worktree without writes; bundle alone omits dirty and untracked state. See docs/GIT_AND_RESTORE.md#源仓库状态与边界.

experiment_round2_3datasets/runs is approximately 47 GiB; source tree approximately 48 GiB. Full private copy and hash manifest must include ignored/untracked evidence. Available space was reported as 172 GiB; this is same-disk capacity, not an offsite backup.

Read-only find identified frozen runs/progress symlinks pointing at absolute source-root paths, plus .venv Python links ending at /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3.12. Do not recursively follow links silently; record link text, target status, and intended restoration mapping.

../myharness has 2 tracked modified files, approximately 112 untracked entries, and 43.59 MiB packed Git history. It is a personal shared harness repository; archive only files demonstrably referenced by this project and their fingerprints, not personal config or the whole repository.

experiment_round2_3datasets/README.md and progress/evidence-manifest.json require retaining full logs/evidence; README warns model outputs cannot be regenerated and signed replay/audit bindings must not be overwritten. Recovery guidance requires hash-first read-only verification and fresh output paths.

Archive scope requires raw conversations, attachments, large evidence, bundles, dirty/untracked backups to remain local private and gitignored. Before first commit verify git status and git check-ignore for every private root; never push.

Filesystem review cannot establish that all chat attachments are present or that external account/service permissions will persist. Record each attachment/reference and availability in the owner manifest; absolute paths and historical grants do not automatically transfer.

docs/GIT_AND_RESTORE.md specifies bundle plus complete dirty/untracked file backup restoration, hash verification first, no reset/clean on originals, and no automatic model or solver rerun. Owner verify_archive.py must enforce copy/link and no-replay boundaries.

limitations: Review did not write to either source repository or perform a Git mutation.
Archive private copy completeness, actual bundle restoration, and source before/after immutability remain to be verified by the archive owner.
Same-disk archival does not protect against disk loss; external permissions and conversation attachment availability require separate confirmation.
